title: Neon Plasma Sphere
description: A glowing plasma globe sits on a metallic base, emitting vibrant pink, purple, and cyan electrical tendrils that branch outward. Some tendrils morph into leaf-like shapes floating in the dark space around the orb.
prompt: A glowing plasma ball with a bright pink core sits on a reflective metallic base, emitting dynamic streams of neon pink, purple, and cyan electricity that branch out like nerves. Several streams transform into floating leaf shapes in the surrounding dark void, creating a surreal fusion of technology and nature, dramatic lighting, cinematic atmosphere.
